name: get_launch_countdown
description: Use this when someone asks how long until GTA 6 launches. Returns the confirmed release date (November 19, 2026, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), the days left, and the exact unlock moments for New Zealand, the United Kingdom and the US East Coast. Optional: an IANA time zone such as "Asia/Kolkata" for that zone's local-midnight unlock.

arguments.name: timezone
arguments.desc: IANA time zone, for example America/Chicago or Asia/Kolkata

name: get_unlock_time
description: Use this when someone asks what time GTA 6 unlocks in a given country. Based on the PlayStation Store listing (local midnight on November 19, 2026). Returns the exact UTC moment, the local wall-clock label, the time-zone abbreviation and the page that explains it. The answer states that Rockstar has not published its own unlock table and that Xbox timing is not confirmed.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Country name, ISO code or alias, for example India, UK, US, BR

annotations.title: GTA 6 unlock time for a country

name: get_price
description: Use this when someone asks what GTA 6 costs in a country. Returns the Standard and Ultimate edition price with how firm the figure is (confirmed from the official store listing, reported, estimate, or billed in US dollars), the source, the date it was last read and, for confirmed markets, an approximate US dollar value at the dated ECB rate. Prices are read from the PlayStation Store and Xbox Store.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Country name, ISO code or alias, for example Japan, Germany, MX

name: list_markets
description: Use this when someone asks which countries GTA 6 prices are tracked for, or which prices are confirmed. Lists every tracked market (98 today) with the price status of each; prices were last fully rechecked on October 24, 2026. Optional filter by status.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Only markets with this price status: confirmed (read from the local store), reported (a named outlet reported it), estimate (not yet confirmed), usd (the store bills in US dollars), none (no local store). Leave out for every market.

annotations.title: Tracked GTA 6 markets and price status

name: get_facts
description: Use this when someone wants to browse the fact database: the list of what Rockstar and Take-Two have confirmed about GTA 6, or everything currently rumored, rather than a ruling on one claim (use check_claim for that). Returns every matching claim with its status (confirmed, likely, unverified, rumor, false, outdated), why, when it was last checked and its source. Optional filters: status, or a keyword.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Only facts with this status. Leave out to include every status.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Keywords every returned fact must contain in its claim or reason, for example "PC" or "open world"

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many facts to return, 1 to 50 (default 25)

name: check_claim
description: Use this when someone asks whether one specific GTA 6 claim or rumor is true (use get_facts to browse the whole database instead). Looks the claim up and returns the closest entries with their status (confirmed, rumor, false and so on), the reason and the source. Returns no match rather than guessing when nothing is close.

arguments.name: claim
arguments.desc: The claim in plain words, for example "GTA 6 is coming to PC at launch"

annotations.title: Check a GTA 6 claim or rumor

name: get_latest_news
description: Use this when someone asks for the latest GTA 6 news. Returns the newest published GTA6 Times stories, each with its label (Confirmed, Reported, Rumor, Leak, Analysis or Guide), a one-line summary, the date and the URL, where the sources are listed.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many stories to return, newest first, 1 to 20

name: get_trailers
description: Use this when someone asks about the official GTA 6 trailers. Returns the videos released by Rockstar (Trailer 1, Trailer 2, An Extended Look, the Launch Trailer) with release dates, lengths where read from the official upload, and the page for each.

name: search_gta6times
description: Use this when someone wants a link to the GTA6 Times page that covers a topic, for people to read (use search and fetch instead when you need the sourced text itself). Searches the site's pages, guides, tools and answers and returns matching pages with a one-line description.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: The topic in plain words, for example "unlock time" or "trailer 3"

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many pages to return, 1 to 15

name: search
description: Use this when someone asks anything about GTA 6 and you need sourced material to answer from (deep research): searches the site's answers, news, facts, markets, trailers and pages. Returns up to 10 results as {id, title, url}; pass an id to the fetch tool for the full text. For a link to hand a person, use search_gta6times.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Plain words, for example "unlock time India" or "PC version"

name: fetch
description: Use this when a search result needs its full text. Pass the id from the search tool (for example "answer:/gta-6/crossplay", "news:<slug>", "fact:<id>", "market:india", "trailer:<slug>"). Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}, with the status and sources included in the text.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: An id returned by the search tool
